CN.limit_detection: an OPEN within 0.005 of round(preclose * (1 +/- price_limit_pct), 2) is flagged MODEL_ONLY_LIMIT_AT_OPEN and kept in the primary result
CN.suspension_rule: a missing next-session bar is a skip; a zero or non-finite volume prevents model execution
CN.transfer_fee_bound: documented omission bounded by about 0.01% of notional per side if applicable

US.spread_source: no quote or spread data exists in the frozen payload; the spread component is the registered scenario bp and is reported as a modelling assumption

decision.censoring_caveat: the registered primary statistic excludes right-censored rows, and censoring is asymmetric: C resolves almost every entry through its 20-session pre-confirmation waiting bound while A and B have no such bound. The final-close valuation sensitivity is therefore reported for all identities; where it reorders the comparison the economic conclusion is treated as not robust to censoring. It never replaces the realized statistic and is never mixed into it
decision.reason: a registered floor failed, so the comparison against the full incumbent is not evaluable at the registered standard; the protocol states that a failed floor yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and never NOT_SUPPORTED. Raw pooled point estimates are kept as reported: C-B 0.3563 and C-A -0.2952
decision.rule_precedence_applied: floors are evaluated before the point-estimate rule because the registered floor derivation states that a failed floor can never produce NOT_SUPPORTED; both the floor state and the raw pooled point estimates are reported

limitations: event-level results are not a portfolio: no concurrency, budget path or holdings state is modelled
CN limit, suspension and lot checks are model-level checks without order-book, queue or real volume evidence
US spread and slippage are scenario assumptions because the frozen payload carries no quotes
the sample window overlaps Development and this sample was already used for the first-stage decision, so it is not a fresh untouched out-of-sample set
